notes.barnes-student-center: The Barnes Student Center holds Baldwin Dining Commons, IWU's main dining hall (indwes.edu/undergraduate/campus-map); its name doesn't say dining.
notes.wesley-seminary: Wesley Seminary is IWU's graduate seminary (wesleyseminary.indwes.edu), not somewhere undergraduates have class.
notes.john-wesley-administration-building: The administration building (indwes.edu/undergraduate/campus-map), offices rather than classrooms.
notes.alumni-center: Alumni centre (indwes.edu/undergraduate/campus-map), not somewhere classes happen.

detours.why: Evans Hall's nearest mapped path is on its east side and the Maxwell Center's on its west; OSM maps no path across the lawn between them, so the walk goes down to University Boulevard and back up.
